name: Amal Alachkar
abstract_title: The Material Substrate for Agency: A DOPA-Based Biophysical Scaffold in the Brain
abstract: My presentation reframes L-3,4-dihydroxyphenylalanine (DOPA) not as a passive precursor for dopamine, but as a fundamental evolutionary scaffold. I trace its journey from its plausible origins in prebiotic chemistry, arguing that the core physicochemical properties of its aromatic catechol group—redox activity, metal chelation, and polymerization—were essential for the emergence of life.
